name: Westfield Culver City
demographics: Westfield Culver City attracts an affluent, trend-conscious demographic typical of the West Los Angeles market, with visitors primarily consisting of middle to upper-income households earning $75,000-$150,000+ annually. The trade area draws a diverse mix of young professionals, families, and entertainment industry workers aged 25-54 who value premium brands and experiential shopping. Shoppers at this location tend to be fashion-forward consumers who appreciate both established international retailers and curated local offerings, with strong preferences for quality dining and entertainment alongside their retail experience.
description: Westfield Culver City, located at 6000 Sepulveda Boulevard, is part of the prestigious global Westfield portfolio that spans over 70 shopping centers across 12 countries. As a premier shopping destination in the Los Angeles area, this dynamic retail center offers an exceptional mix of global and local brands including iconic retailers like Nike, Zara, Sephora, H&M, Swarovski, and Aésop. The center is designed to be more than just a shopping mall—it's a vibrant entertainment and lifestyle destination featuring world-class dining options, from international cuisine staples to local eateries, all wrapped in beautiful architecture and modern design. Westfield Culver City provides shoppers with convenient amenities including smart parking technology and click-and-collect services, making it easy for quick trips or enjoyable all-day experiences. As part of the Westfield brand's commitment to creating unforgettable experiences, the center enriches the Culver City community by serving as a hub for inspiration, entertainment, social connection, and trend-forward fashion.
summary: Westfield Culver City is a premier shopping and entertainment destination featuring top global brands like Nike, Zara, Sephora, and Swarovski alongside diverse dining options and modern conveniences. Part of the world-renowned Westfield portfolio, this dynamic center serves as a community hub for fashion, food, leisure, and entertainment in the heart of Culver City.
